title: brain-connector.json
description: Universal Brain Connector Protocol v1 (Plan 06). Declares how a project feeds Brain. Reverse-engineered from brain-connector-runner.mjs (the runner is the source of truth for which fields are honored), so this schema is a faithful authoring contract, not an aspirational one.

project.description: Stable project identifier, e.g. "catalog-service" or "agent-manager". Exported to adapters as BRAIN_CONNECTOR_PROJECT.

version.description: Connector protocol version. Only "1" is defined. Runner defaults a missing value to "1".

brain_url.description: Base URL of the Brain server. Runner defaults to $BRAIN_URL or http://127.0.0.1:4200 and exports it to adapters as BRAIN_URL.

notes.description: Free-form operator notes. Ignored by the runner.

feeds.description: One entry per data feed. Feeds with no name are dropped by the runner.

name.description: Feed name, unique within the connector. Exported as BRAIN_CONNECTOR_FEED_NAME and used in cursor-state filenames.

type.description: "poll" runs the script on interval_seconds. "event" long-polls an event stream and hands each batch to the script (unless managed_by is set, in which case it is register-only).

produces.description: Brain ingest data-kinds this feed writes. Each maps to a verified POST endpoint (see brain-connector-adapter-contract.md).

source.description: Logical source tag written into Brain rows (entities.source, timeline.source, facts.source). Exported as BRAIN_CONNECTOR_FEED_SOURCE.

script.description: Adapter script path (relative to the connector file, or absolute). Required for poll feeds; for event feeds, either script OR an event stream URL is required. *.mjs/*.cjs/*.js/*.ts run under node; anything else is exec'd directly.

interval_seconds.description: Poll cadence in seconds (default 3600). Runner clamps to >= 1.

intervalSeconds.description: camelCase alias for interval_seconds (runner accepts both).

event_stream.description: Event stream URL for event feeds. Runner long-polls it with the cursor param (default "since" for /events URLs, else "cursor") plus &wait=. Canonical field honored by the runner's eventStreamUrl() resolver.

managed_by.description: launchd unit (or other supervisor) that already runs this feed externally. The runner treats such event feeds as register-only (logs event_feed_managed_externally; does NOT start a second consumer).

cursor.description: Initial cursor for event long-poll. Overridden by persisted cursor state once the feed has run.

since.description: Alias for cursor (runner reads cursor ?? since ?? start_cursor ?? startCursor).

cursor_param.description: Override the query-param name used to send the cursor (default "since" for /events URLs, else "cursor").

wait_seconds.description: Long-poll wait window in seconds for event feeds. Runner clamps to [1,120] (default 30).

placeholder.description: Mark a feed as an intentional stub that has no runner yet (no script / no event stream). When true, the runner-required check is waived; the runner skips it cleanly (adapter_skipped / event_skipped) until its source exists. Makes 'not wired yet' explicit so an accidental omission is still flagged.

then.description: Poll feeds must declare a script to run on interval (or be marked placeholder: true).
Event feeds must declare a supervised script OR a runner-recognized event stream URL (or be marked placeholder: true).
